operating_rules.priority_order: higher priority first; tie break by store id ascending
operating_rules.fulfillment_rule: For each SKU independently, allocate total available inventory to stores by priority order until stock is exhausted.
operating_rules.source_rule: For each store in priority order and for each SKU in sku_processing_order, source fulfilled units from the nearest warehouse with remaining SKU inventory; tie break by warehouse name ascending.
operating_rules.sla_rule: A store is on time only if all planned shipments to that store arrive no later than the store deadline.
operating_rules.rounding: Report money to 2 decimals, distances to 1 decimal when needed, minutes to 1 decimal when needed, and times as HH:MM:SS. Do not round intermediate inventory units.

disruption.description: Road South-S4 is closed from 08:30 to 09:30.

A_overtime_early_dispatch.description: Dispatch V2 at 08:10 and use the disruption detour route South-S3-S4-S1-South. S3 is pass-through only.

B_charter_microvan.description: Use a charter microvan for South->S4 via an unaffected 20 km local road at 08:30; V2 only serves South->S1->South.

C_no_mitigation.description: Use the disruption detour route without early dispatch or charter support.
